interpretation: Only source-hash and analytic formula checks in this file were executed. Every V7 simulation check is predeclared and not run; none is evidence that a future implementation passes.

source_provenance.parity_method: SHA-256 of local file versus raw.githubusercontent.com file at pinned commit

occupancy.method: independent closed-form derivation, bounded scalar optimization, and direct Monte Carlo Poisson splitting
occupancy.arrival_process: Poisson encounters of rate nu*d, uniformly split among M items

arrival_process_counterexample.implication: The exponential occupancy expression is not the fixed-count occupancy expression; implementation must declare and test its arrival process.

occupancy.claim_limit: This verifies a reduced scalar diagnostic, not the V7 vector-policy simulation or an empirical interior optimum.

multiplicative_risk.method: independent derivative calculation and bounded scalar optimization
multiplicative_risk.claim_limit: This does not validate a growth measure for overlapping ages, density dependence, idiosyncratic within-population risk, or extinction.

checks.claim_guarded: extra authority override has an effect beyond ordinary social learning
checks.design: Freeze initial state, private evidence, message content, demonstrations, estimated source reliability, event budget, and random event identities. Compute the neutral social-learning posterior/action first; apply d only to logged recommendation conflicts.
checks.acceptance_criterion: Before override, all d genotypes have bitwise-identical beliefs, material action values, source estimates, acquired procedure memory, and remaining budgets. Changing d changes only conflict decisions and their downstream mediated consequences.

checks.claim_guarded: authority label rather than information content causes the response
checks.design: Randomize an explicitly uninformative authority/age label after generating an identical message and evidence history; include label-neutral and authority-sensitive policies.
checks.acceptance_criterion: Label-neutral policy has zero paired label effect within numerical tolerance and source-label permutations are exchangeable. Any authority-sensitive effect is reported as an intention-to-treat label contrast, not only among endogenous conflicts.

checks.claim_guarded: acquisition, memory acceptance, and behavioral override are distinct mechanisms
checks.design: Run a joint-exposure 2x2 accept-to-memory by conflict-override factorial while holding message exposure fixed.
checks.acceptance_criterion: The four cells differ only in the declared switch. Belief, procedure memory, public action, and later behavior are separately exported.
checks.failure_disposition: block construct-specific claims and report bundled copying only

checks.claim_guarded: genotype transmits policy but not factual or procedural content
checks.design: At birth inspect state before any exposure; permute parental knowledge within genotype; cross-foster newborns; relabel task nodes and solution branches in held-out worlds.
checks.acceptance_criterion: Newborn K, factual B, provenance, habit/norm state, and task-specific values are blank. Content follows post-birth teachers, not biological parent. Task relabeling destroys any task-specific solution advantage unless an informative prior is explicitly declared.

checks.claim_guarded: founder competence is acquired rather than silently seeded or survivor-selected
checks.design: Run blank, sparse-private, ordinary learned, alternative/wrong-culture, and failed-burn-in initializations with equal logged budgets.
checks.acceptance_criterion: No founder begins with evaluator truth or a correct procedure. Every competent component traces to a logged acquisition/innovation event. Failed cultures remain in unconditional summaries.
required_outputs: all attempted founder cultures including failures
checks.failure_disposition: block cultural accumulation and demographic benefit claims

checks.claim_guarded: focal policy beats a strong ordinary-learning comparator
checks.design: Compare with an exact tiny-world Bayes-adaptive planner and a provenance-aware resource-rational learned-trust approximation, using identical observations, utility, event budget, and separately tuned/frozen hyperparameters.
checks.acceptance_criterion: Exact policy weakly upper-bounds every restricted focal policy under identical information and utility. Approximate comparator receives equal training and charged computation. All operation/time costs are reported.
checks.failure_disposition: block specialized-adaptation claim; classify any excess over exact policy as mismatch or bug

checks.claim_guarded: differences are policy allocation effects rather than unequal abilities or free computation
checks.design: Yoke sensor likelihoods, memory capacity, innovation success conditional on an experiment, action opportunities, and computation/event endowment across genotypes. Charge optional extra operations.
checks.acceptance_criterion: On a forced common action/event history, all genotypes produce identical observations and competence transitions and finish with identical resource balances.

checks.claim_guarded: social/cultural advantage is not manufactured by a needle-in-a-haystack task
checks.design: Enumerate tiny solution landscapes and sample larger graph ensembles. Measure viable solution count, useful prefix rewards, safe alternative yield, private-discovery probability, and minimal pruned successful depth.
checks.acceptance_criterion: Primary worlds have at least two viable solution families, nonzero partial rewards, a safe low-yield option, and nonzero independent success under matched total work. Results survive label permutation, prerequisite shuffling, and no-op pruning.
checks.failure_disposition: block adaptation/generalization claim for that task world

checks.claim_guarded: cross-generation transmission produces cumulative procedural progress
checks.design: Track immutable procedure genealogy, modifications, and held-out task performance. Compare actual transmission+innovation with no transmission at matched per-person and total work, transmission without modification, innovation without retention, and shuffled prerequisites.
checks.acceptance_criterion: Improved held-out functional performance traces across at least two transmission edges and depends on both retention and modification. Counts, confidence, and nominal recipe length alone never satisfy the check.
checks.failure_disposition: block cumulative-culture claim; report storage, diffusion, or within-generation innovation instead

checks.claim_guarded: culture does not persist without carriers unless storage is enabled
checks.design: Remove all living carriers at a checkpoint and restart with naive agents, with artifact storage disabled and enabled in separate costed conditions.
checks.acceptance_criterion: With storage disabled, no procedure/provenance state survives total carrier loss. With storage enabled, every recovered item traces to a stored artifact and its storage/reading costs.

checks.claim_guarded: correlated testimony is not double counted as independent evidence
checks.design: Duplicate an identical message along the same disclosed root lineage; separately vary the number of unique physical root trials while holding message count/content fixed.
checks.acceptance_criterion: A provenance-aware learner's physical-evidence posterior is invariant to same-root duplication except for separately modeled transmission-fidelity evidence. Merged provenance uses unique-root set union, not path counts.
checks.failure_disposition: block evidential and authority-effect claims involving repeated testimony

checks.claim_guarded: intermediate behavior is correctly classified as within-agent stochasticity, conditional policy, or polymorphism
checks.design: Validate the reporting classifier on synthetic fixtures for all three generators, then export individual policy parameters and repeated identical-state responses.
checks.acceptance_criterion: Synthetic fixtures are classified correctly. Simulation reports within-agent repeated-state acceptance, conditional response surface, and between-agent trait distribution; no population mean substitutes for these.

checks.claim_guarded: later maturity is favored by a declared tradeoff rather than hidden forced behavior
checks.design: Pair an earlier-eligible agent with a later-eligible agent and force the earlier agent to use the later agent's reproduction schedule under identical events.
checks.acceptance_criterion: Without an explicit developmental/reproductive investment tradeoff, state and resource paths are identical. Any divergence is explained by a declared mechanism.
checks.failure_disposition: do not interpret a later-maturity optimum

checks.claim_guarded: population and energy/resource accounting closes
checks.design: Assign a unique ID to every production, maintenance, experiment, teaching, transfer, reproduction, birth, and death event; independently sum ledgers by agent and population.
checks.acceptance_criterion: N(t+1)-N(t)=births-deaths exactly. Agent and population energy changes equal declared sources minus sinks; internal transfers net to zero apart from declared efficiency loss. No event is charged twice or omitted.
checks.failure_disposition: block all demographic and fitness claims

checks.claim_guarded: teaching, provisioning, and access transfers are not free or double counted
checks.design: For every transfer or teaching event, link donor debit, recipient credit, conversion loss, time cost, and content exposure by one event ID.
checks.acceptance_criterion: Removing the event removes both sides. Food/protection/access effects are not also inserted as direct fecundity or obedience bonuses. Teacher opportunity cost is explicit.

checks.claim_guarded: growth and extinction are not survivor conditioned
checks.design: Retain every replicate, including extinct populations and lineages. Report extinction probability and a prespecified unconditional finite-window/branching growth estimand; label any conditional-positive-lineage statistic separately.
checks.acceptance_criterion: No primary mean drops extinct runs or replaces zero abundance silently. Regulated abundance, low-density growth, rare-lineage growth, and extinction are distinct metrics with explicit denominators.

checks.claim_guarded: rare mutants experience the actual resident cultural environment
checks.design: Introduce default mutants as newborns into resident populations. Log every teacher candidate and selected teacher; compare oblique and explicitly vertical transmission.
checks.acceptance_criterion: As mutant frequency tends to zero, oblique teacher-source genotype frequencies converge to the reachable resident pool and do not become an all-mutant pool. Vertical assays preserve mutant parent-offspring linkage. Warm-started adults are separate.
required_outputs: teacher pool and selected teacher genotypes

checks.claim_guarded: selection signal is not numerical or identity asymmetry
checks.design: Run resident against itself, label exchange, genotype exchange, and neutral-trait competitions under paired event streams.
checks.acceptance_criterion: Self-mutant expected growth is zero within prespecified Monte Carlo precision; exchanging labels/genotypes changes only sign or leaves neutral outcomes invariant as appropriate.

checks.claim_guarded: factual dogmatism is distinguished from strong priors, missing evidence, and normative action persistence
checks.design: Apply bidirectional matched-likelihood evidence sequences after matching prior confidence/resources; remove audience, sanctions, rewards, and material access separately; run free audit.
checks.acceptance_criterion: Dogmatism is declared only for a deficient or source-asymmetric factual revision slope versus a likelihood-aware benchmark. Action persistence with adequate factual revision is not called dogmatism.

checks.claim_guarded: persistent action is normative commitment rather than cached instrumental habit
checks.design: After audience removal and evidence equalization, add outcome devaluation, contingency degradation, obligation generalization to novel contexts, and explicit countermand probes.
checks.acceptance_criterion: Normative state, habit value, belief, and current material value are separately represented and exported. If the probes cannot distinguish them, use the label learned action persistence only.

checks.claim_guarded: policy effects are not caused by sequential random-stream desynchronization
checks.design: Key exogenous randomness by replicate, world, time, entity, and event type; separate environmental, demographic, innovation, and observation namespaces.
checks.acceptance_criterion: Adding an unused policy-specific draw or changing the number of decisions leaves all later exogenous events for shared identities unchanged.

checks.claim_guarded: ordinary agents do not use evaluator-only hidden state
checks.design: Audit typed policy inputs and permute hidden-state labels while holding observations fixed. Keep oracle capabilities in a separate declared interface.
checks.acceptance_criterion: Ordinary-policy outputs are invariant to hidden-state relabeling conditional on identical observations. No true graph, correctness, source reliability, future change time, or evaluator label enters the policy input.
checks.failure_disposition: block all learning and adaptation claims

checks.claim_guarded: multiplicative-risk interpretation uses the correct growth object
checks.design: Derive or numerically validate the low-density random projection/branching growth measure for the actual age-structured process and separate shared environmental from idiosyncratic risk.
checks.acceptance_criterion: Tiny limiting cases reproduce exact scalar and matrix results; arithmetic abundance, mean instantaneous eigenvalues, and survivor-conditioned logs are not substituted for the prespecified growth measure.
checks.failure_disposition: do not interpret an interior as a multiplicative-risk result

checks.claim_guarded: conditional mechanism estimates are not collider-selected
checks.design: Report unconditional intention-to-treat contrasts and induce conflicts from common frozen pre-override states. Track policy effects on teacher availability, survival, audit eligibility, and disagreement.
checks.acceptance_criterion: Every conditional contrast names its denominator and selection rule; primary causal claims do not rely solely on naturally observed policy-affected subsets.

checks.claim_guarded: figures and dashboard claims reflect exact exported simulation data
checks.design: Recompute every displayed aggregate from immutable raw/summary exports and compare hashes, values, denominators, and configuration metadata.
checks.acceptance_criterion: All displayed values match recomputation within declared serialization tolerance; interpolated cells are labeled and never enter inference as observations.

additional_hypotheses.name: metareasoning equivalence
additional_hypotheses.hypothesis: An apparent inherited-authority advantage disappears when a provenance-aware learned-trust learner receives matched calibration experience and computation.
additional_hypotheses.rival: Inherited deference is a lower-cost informative prior that remains advantageous in short lives.
additional_hypotheses.discriminating_test: Cross lifetime length, calibration cost, and free audit on held-out relabeled graphs; decompose any advantage into prior information, search allocation, and execution override.

additional_hypotheses.name: provenance saturation
additional_hypotheses.hypothesis: Benefits attributed to authoritative repetition shrink when unique evidential roots are tracked.
additional_hypotheses.rival: Repeated messages carry independent evidence about transmission fidelity or consensus despite shared roots.
additional_hypotheses.discriminating_test: Hold message count/content fixed while varying unique root trials and disclosed lineage; cross provenance-aware and blind learners.

counterexamples.statement: A conditional corner policy d_procedure=1,d_local=0 can dominate every scalar d even when the scalar restriction has an interior optimum.
counterexamples.implication: A scalar interior can be omitted-variable compromise, not an interior individual disposition.

counterexamples.statement: Cached instrumental habit can persist after audience removal while factual beliefs revise normally.
counterexamples.implication: Persistence under the three proposed adult interventions is insufficient by itself to identify normative internalization.
